records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $50.0, or 3.7%, in the first quarter of 2021 relative to the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This increase is due to improved unit sales across most products, resulting from continued improvement in business activity among our traditional manufacturing and construction customers as well as higher sales of COVID-related PPE to traditional, government, and healthcare customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the same time, demand for most pandemic-related PPE from our customers, including government, has begun to moderate, and this combined with an oversupply in the marketplace resulted in a financial write-down of our 3-ply mask inventory in the period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The overall impact of product pricing on net sales was 60 to 90 basis points during the first quarter of 2021; this compares to an immaterial impact in the fourth quarter of 2020 and a 30 to 60 basis points impact in the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities increased in the first quarter of 2021 relative to the first quarter of 2020.
